BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain floor-tile)
  (:requirements :typing :action-costs)
  (:types robot tile color)
  (:predicates
    (robot-at ?r - robot ?t - tile)
    (robot-has ?r - robot ?c - color)
    (available-color ?c - color)
    (clear ?t - tile)
    (painted ?t - tile ?c - color)
    (up ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile)
    (down ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile)
    (right ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile)
    (left ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile)
  )
  (:functions (total-cost))

  (:action change-color
    :parameters (?r - robot ?c - color)
    :precondition (and (available-color ?c))
    :effect (and
      (forall (?c2 - color)
        (when (robot-has ?r ?c2) (not (robot-has ?r ?c2))))
      (robot-has ?r ?c)
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  (:action paint-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?t1)
      (up ?t2 ?t1)
      (robot-has ?r ?c)
      (clear ?t2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (clear ?t2))
      (painted ?t2 ?c)
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

    :parameters (?r - robot ?t1 - tile ?t2 - tile ?c - color)
